headline: Bitcoin Rebounds Following Midterm Elections as DeFi Tokens Lead Gains
summary: Bitcoin recovered from a dip to approximately $75,600 following the Democratic victory in Congress. Meanwhile, decentralized finance tokens led market gains while Trump-linked coins experienced declines.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization, often serving as a barometer for broader digital asset sentiment and macroeconomic liquidity expectations.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin recovered from its midterm dip to trade higher around the $75,600 level.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Bitcoin rebounded as political shifts in Congress altered crypto sector sentiment, driving gains across decentralized finance tokens.
